findings.title: float:right on flex item is ignored, button loses right alignment
findings.body: In app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/topic-post.scss .small-action is now a flex container via flexbox() mixin, so its direct children (.topic-avatar, .small-action-desc, button) are flex items. Per CSS Flexbox spec, float and clear have no effect on flex items. The button rule still uses float: right to push the dismiss/close button to the far right, which will now compute to none and the button will render immediately after the description instead of at the right edge. Fix by using margin-left: auto or justify-content on the flex container instead of float.

findings.title: order mixin off-by-one for legacy -webkit-box-ordinal-group
findings.body: In app/assets/stylesheets/common/foundation/mixins.scss the order() mixin emits -webkit-box-ordinal-group: $val with the same value as order: $val. The 2009 box spec is 1-indexed (ordinal-group = order + 1, default 1 equals order 0), so order(2) and order(3) used in topic.scss and header.scss produce ordinal-group 2/3 which correspond to modern order 1/2. Modern browsers and legacy WebKit (Safari 6, iOS 6, old Android) will compute different orders, causing inconsistent header/extra-info/panel ordering. It should emit -webkit-box-ordinal-group: $val + 1 and -moz-box-ordinal-group accordingly.

findings.title: margin-left:auto does not right-align in legacy -webkit-box fallback
findings.body: In app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/header.scss .d-header .panel uses margin-left: auto to push the panel to the right inside .contents which now uses display: -webkit-box / flex via mixins. Auto margins only absorb free space in the modern flexbox spec; the 2009 -webkit-box implementation does not support pushing items with auto margins and has no box-pack set. Legacy WebKit that only understands display: -webkit-box will therefore left-align the panel next to the title instead of right-aligning it, breaking the header despite the prefixes.

findings.title: Invalid -ms-align-items property in align-items mixin
findings.body: In app/assets/stylesheets/common/foundation/mixins.scss align-items() emits -ms-align-items: $alignment which is not a real CSS property and is ignored by all browsers. IE10/11 only understand -ms-flex-align (already emitted) for this, so the extra declaration is dead code and suggests the prefix mapping was not verified. Remove it to avoid confusion and false confidence in IE alignment, especially for align-items(baseline) used by badges.
